tools.name: atos_search
tools.description: Search and rank ATOS capabilities by natural-language intent and constraints.

tools.name: atos_get_capability
tools.description: Get full metadata and schemas for one capability.

tools.name: atos_quote
tools.description: Create a time-limited executable commercial quote for a capability.

tools.name: atos_invoke
tools.description: Invoke a bounded capability using an executable quote.

tools.name: atos_create_job
tools.description: Create a long-running or interactive ATOS job.

tools.name: atos_get_job
tools.description: Get the current state, messages and artifacts of an ATOS job.

tools.name: atos_cancel_job
tools.description: Request cancellation of a non-terminal ATOS job.

tools.name: atos_register_capability
tools.description: Register a provider capability on ATOS.

tools.name: atos_update_capability
tools.description: Update mutable metadata/configuration of a capability owned by the authenticated provider.

tools.name: atos_account
tools.description: Get account balance, usage and autonomous spending policy.

optional_tools._comment: Not part of the default 10-tool surface (see docs/MCP.md 'Keep the default tool list small'). Advertise only when relevant, e.g. provider/admin scope or a capability's schema references a file field.

file_transfer.name: atos_create_upload
file_transfer.description: Request a short-lived signed upload target for binary content.

file_transfer.name: atos_complete_upload
file_transfer.description: Finalize an upload after PUTing bytes to the signed upload_url, returning a reusable artifact_id.

file_transfer.name: atos_get_download_url
file_transfer.description: Get a short-lived signed download URL for an artifact the caller owns.
